name: Mustelidays
source:
Mustelidays is a Slice of Life visual novel with subtle elements of Horror, and Romance! Taking place in 2004, you follow 19 year old sable marten, Bryer Zhou during his college winter break, where he resolves to ensure he doesn't drift far from his friends.

In the small town of Newland, Seminolia, college break has just began, and your friends are no longer bound together by class schedules, or routine. Life has a funny way of stealing the attention of others. And while you can't force everyone to stay together, you don't plan on staying all on your own, right?
translation:
《鼬科日常》（Mustelidays）是一部融入了淡淡恐怖与恋爱元素的日常系视觉小说！故事发生在2004年，你将追随19岁的紫貂大学生布莱尔·周度过大学寒假——他暗下决心，绝不让自己与朋友们渐行渐远。

在塞米诺利亚的新兰小镇，大学假期才刚刚开始，朋友们不再受课程表与固定作息的束缚聚在一起。生活总是会在不知不觉间夺走他人的注意力；虽说你没法强求所有人都留在原地，但你总不打算孤零零地一个人度过假期吧？
